surface_mechanism_description: The Al doping effect caused by the thermal diffusion of Al from the sapphire into the ZnO reduces nonradiative recombination, leading to a lower stimulated emission threshold.
evidence: Al doping in the ZnO film results in the increase in electron concentration and the decrease in the oxygen vacancies, which in turn reduce the nonradiative recombination, Al2O3 + V••o → 2Al•Zn + 3O×o. Thus, the Al doping effect also leads to the lowering of the stimulated emission threshold in the ZnO films.
